subject: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence sprint & trust vault access
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Matt Lutz <mlutz@clearwellhealth.com>, security@clearwellhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence sprint & trust vault access

Hi Matt / ClearWell security team —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the compliance review forward: 

1) Deliverables we can provide this week:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) + bridge letter confirming scope & period
   - Short attestation on GDPR/HIPAA controls that map to your questionnaire sections
   - Invite to our Trust Vault (secure evidence portal) so you can pull artifacts directly

2) Questions we need from you to scope the evidence sprint:
   - Confirm which services you consider in-scope (API, Redwood Dedicated, and any private VPC deployments)
   - Any specific controls or subprocesses you need evidence for (data retention, key management, user access logs)

3) Timelines: if you accept portal access, we can upload the SOC 2 + bridge letter and a starter evidence packet by EOD Wednesday (May 19). For the vendor security questionnaire, our target turnaround is 3-5 business days after we receive the DSQ.

Please confirm the in-scope services and whether you prefer the report via portal link or an emailed PDF. If you want us to complete a vendor questionnaire, attach it to your reply and we’ll queue it.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Security & GTM
Redwood Inference

--

From: Matt Lutz <mlutz@clearwellhealth.com>

Cc: security@clearwellhealth.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence sprint & trust vault access

Thanks, Evelyn — really helpful recap. 

A few quick items from our side: 
- In-scope: API + Hosted (we are not bringing Dedicated yet) and any telemetry pipelines that store PHI.
- Controls we care most about: encryption at rest, KMS/HSM use, audit logging retention, and incident response.
- We prefer the Trust Vault invite so our InfoSec team can pull artifacts. PDF is fine as a fallback.

I've attached the vendor security questionnaire (VSA) — please confirm receipt and an estimated completion date. Also, for the SOC 2, can you indicate the report period and auditor name in the bridge letter? That will help our auditors validate the scope quickly.

Thanks — I copied our security mailbox to keep the request tracked.

Matt Lutz
Director, Information Security
ClearWell Health

--

Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence sprint & trust vault access

Matt — thanks for the details and the VSA. Confirming our plan: 

- We'll upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF and a bridge letter that states the report period (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) and auditor (ClearPath LLP). Bridge letter will call out the services in scope (API + Hosted inference).
- I'll publish a starter evidence packet covering KMS/HSM configs, encryption at rest, and recent audit logs.
- We'll invite security@clearwellhealth.com to our Trust Vault. Expect the invite + initial uploads by EOD tomorrow (May 20).

Next steps for you (ClearWell):
- Confirm you only need Hosted & API in-scope (Matt said yes in his reply)
- If you want more granular logs (e.g., per-tenant audit trails), tell us which date ranges you need

Evelyn / Aditya — I’ll take point on the upload and DSQ completion. I’ll mark any VSA fields that need engineering input and loop the right folks.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales (Security Liaison)
Redwood Inference
